resources.name: No Trace (Stationary)
resources.description: Enable after remaining stationary without acting for at least 1 round. The insight bonus applies to Disguise and opposed Stealth checks; the same scaling increase to tracking DC remains documented in Special Abilities.

notes: Ki, Sneak Attack, Ninja Tricks and Master Tricks use shared trackers and power catalogs. No Trace has an explicit situational toggle; Light Steps and Hidden Master remain rules-visible actions powered by the same character state.
